Message.Name: Order Cancel Request Message
Message.Description: This message is used to cancel a single targeted order. Populate the field OrigClOrdID with the ClOrdID of the order intended for cancellation.

Field.Name: SymbolID
Field.Description: Identification number assigned to the security.

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Firm Identifier – MPID. Must match the MPID of the order intended for cancellation.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of the new Order, Cancel/Replace, Cancel, Modify, or Bulk Cancel request as assigned by the firm. Pillar validates uniqueness for Username + MPID among open orders; firm is responsible for ensuring uniqueness for the full trading day.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Refers to the ClOrdID of a previously entered order.

Message.Name: Order Modify Request Message
Message.Description: This message is used to reduce the total order quantity or change the side of an existing order between Sell, Sell Short, and Sell Short Exempt while preserving the order’s ranking and original OrderID. The modified order receives a new ClOrdID equal to the ClOrdID of the Modify Request. Reducing the total quantity to 0 will cancel the order.

Field.Name: SymbolID
Field.Description: Identification number assigned to the security.

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Firm Identifier – MPID. Must match the MPID of the order intended for modification.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of the Modify request as assigned by the firm. Pillar validates uniqueness for Username + MPID among open orders; the firm is responsible for ensuring uniqueness for the full trading day.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Refers to the ClOrdID of a previously entered order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: New desired order quantity (1–999,999,999). Only quantity reductions are allowed via a Modify Request.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side

Field.Name: LocateReqd
Field.Description: 0 = No LocateReqd or not applicable. Orders with Side of Sell Short, Sell Short Exempt, Cross Short, or Cross Short Exempt must be entered with LocateReqd = 0 or will be rejected.

Message.Name: Bulk Cancel Request Message
Message.Description: This message is used to bulk cancel multiple orders based on the specified combination of criteria. MPID must be valid for the session. Depending on BulkCancelType, cancellation may apply at the session or MPID level. Certain order types are always excluded from bulk cancellation.

Field.Name: SymbolID
Field.Description: Identification number assigned to the security.

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Firm Identifier – MPID.

Field.Name: MMID
Field.Description: Integer identifier of a Market Maker, LMM, SLP, SLMM, or DMM. If specified, limits cancellation scope to Q Orders entered with the specified MMID.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of the Bulk Cancel request as assigned by the firm. Must be unique for Username + MPID for the trading day.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Not applicable.

Field.Name: BulkCancelType
Field.Description: Cancellation scope and behavior code

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side

Message.Name: Symbol Subscription Request Message

Field.Name: SymbolID

Field.Name: Username

Message.Name: TG Begin Message
Message.Description: This is used to define the beginning boundary of a multi-message originating from the firm, which is a sequence of messages that is intended to be read and processed atomically by Pillar.

Message.Name: TG End Message
Message.Description: This is used to define the ending boundary of a multi-message, which is a set of messages originating from the firm that is intended to be read and processed atomically by Pillar.

Message.Name: Manual Action Response Message
Message.Description: Response message used by a DMM to approve or reject a Manual Action Request. Depending on the ManualResponseType, this message may result in order creation or rejection with an optional reject reason.

Field.Name: SymbolID
Field.Description: Identification number assigned to the security.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of the Manual Action Response assigned by the firm. Echoed back if the response is rejected.

Field.Name: ManualActionID
Field.Description: Unique ID of the corresponding Manual Action Request.

Field.Name: SellIndicator
Field.Description: Sets the side for DMM requested quantity: 0=Not applicable, 2=Sell, 3=Sell Short, 4=Sell Short Exempt. Applicability depends on ManualActionType and request side.

Field.Name: IntradaySellShortQty
Field.Description: Number of shares to mark as Sell Short for applicable ManualActionTypes. Populate 0 when not applicable.

Field.Name: MPSubID
Field.Description: Customer-defined identifier for a specific entity or trading desk, applied to resulting manual DMM order.

Field.Name: LocateReqd
Field.Description: Locate requirement indicator: 0=No LocateReqd, 1=LocateReqd for Sell Short orders.

Field.Name: SelfTradeType
Field.Description: Self-trade prevention setting: 0=Use default/Cancel Newest, 1=No STP, 2=Cancel Newest, 3=Cancel Oldest, 4=Cancel Both, 5=Cancel Decrement.

Field.Name: UserData
Field.Description: Customer-defined data applied to resulting order for applicable ManualActionTypes. Printable ASCII only.

Field.Name: ManualResponseType
Field.Description: Response type: 1=Approve Manual Action Request, 2=Reject Manual Action Request.

Field.Name: DMMRejectReason
Field.Description: Optional reject reason displayed on DBK GUI when ManualResponseType=2. Printable ASCII only.

Message.Name: Risk Limit Update Request Message
Message.Description: Risk limit update request used by Risk Admin to configure or update risk controls for a specified risk entity. Field applicability depends on RiskControlType; non-applicable fields should be set to 0 or ignored as documented.

Field.Name: SymbolID
Field.Description: Risk Entity – Symbol (equities) or Underlying Symbol (options). Identification number assigned to the security. Required for RiskControlType=Reject Restricted Symbol; may optionally be populated for certain activity-based and symbol-specific controls; ignored for other RiskControlTypes.

Field.Name: MPID
Field.Description: Risk Entity. Firm Identifier – MPID. Required.

Field.Name: MarketMaker
Field.Description: Risk Entity. Options Market Maker identifier – alphanumeric MMID associated with the specified MPID. Populate if applicable.

Field.Name: MPSubID
Field.Description: Risk Entity – SubID associated with the specified MPID. Populate if applicable.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Bytes reserved for future use.

Field.Name: ClearingNumber
Field.Description: Reserved for future use. Risk Entity – Clearing Number associated with the specified MPID. Populate if applicable.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of request as assigned by the firm. Firm must ensure uniqueness for full trading day by Username + MPID; Pillar does not enforce this. Customer defined.

Field.Name: RiskUserCRD
Field.Description: Risk User – CRD of the firm that owns the risk control represented by this message.

Field.Name: RiskUserType
Field.Description: Risk User – type of firm that owns the risk control represented by this message. E = Entering Firm, C = Clearing Firm, O = Options Market Maker Firm.

Field.Name: RiskControlType
Field.Description: Risk Control Type enum

Field.Name: RiskControlActivation
Field.Description: Risk Control Activation enum

Field.Name: USDLimit
Field.Description: US Dollar limit. Must be specified for RiskControlTypes: Single Order Max Notional Value; Gross Credit – Executed/Open/Open+Executed; Limit Order Price Protection – Custom Limits. For other RiskControlTypes set to 0.

Field.Name: TimeLimit
Field.Description: Microsecond time period. Must be specified for RiskControlTypes: Activity-based Rolling Transaction/Volume/Percentage; Activity-based Global Risk Mitigation Protection; Max Duplicative Orders; Order Rate Threshold – Max Orders across All Symbols. For other RiskControlTypes set to 0.

Field.Name: PercentageLimit
Field.Description: Percentage (%). Must be specified for RiskControlTypes: Activity-based – Percentage; Limit Order Price Protection – Custom Limits; Single Order Maximum Quantity as Percentage of Symbol ADV. For other RiskControlTypes set to 0.

Field.Name: CountLimit
Field.Description: Count

Field.Name: BreachActionRequest
Field.Description: Breach Action Request enum

Field.Name: IOCAttribution
Field.Description: IOC Attribution enum

Field.Name: RiskRangeID
Field.Description: Quantity or price range to which the risk limit is applied. 0=Not Applicable/Optional per RiskControlType, 1..10=[see below]. Range meanings depend on RiskControlType (e.g., ADV buckets for RiskControlType 22; price buckets for RiskControlType 23).

Field.Name: RiskMinimumValue
Field.Description: Minimum value for which to apply the risk control. For RiskControlType 22 may specify minimum Symbol ADV threshold; for other RiskControlTypes set to 0.

Field.Name: PriceScale
Field.Description: 0=no decimals; interpret as integer. 2=two decimals; interpret with two decimals (e.g., USDLimit=25 with PriceScale=2 represents $0.25). Must be specified for Limit Order Price Protection - Custom Limits and applied to USDLimit; otherwise set to 0.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Bytes reserved for future use.
